description: This source file defines a static class 'ApiErrorHandling' which provides centralized error handling utilities for a web API. It includes methods to register a global exception handler that transforms exceptions into standardized ProblemDetails responses, mapping specific exceptions to HTTP status codes, and logging the exceptions accordingly.

classes.name: ApiErrorHandling
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods and helpers for centralized API error handling and exception-to-HTTP response mapping.

methods.name: UseUnifiedExceptionHandling
methods.description: Registers global exception handling middleware in the web application pipeline that converts uncaught exceptions into standardized HTTP responses with ProblemDetails.

methods.name: ToResult
methods.description: Converts an exception into an IResult containing a ProblemDetails object, with logic to handle different exception types and map them to appropriate HTTP status codes.

methods.name: MapException
methods.description: Maps specific exception types to HTTP status codes, titles, and details, enabling consistent error responses.
